CMU Poker AI Doing Phenomenally Well Against Strong Heads Up Players In No Limit Texas Hold'em

While it's easy to be an armchair critic, I'm not terribly impressed by the AI methods they're using. It seems that the team is fundamentally just mapping the game into a simpler game by abstracting the bet size to a variety of fixed values (eg - instead of one being able to bet anything from 0-200 chips or big blinds, it's able to bet x, y, or z chips) to reduce the search space and then trying to brute force it. It's resulting in some lengthy move times for the computer, and is something that wouldn't really work so well for anything except precisely a poker bot, unlike their article implies:

Ultimately programs like Libratus also could be used to negotiate business deals, set military strategy or plan a course of medical treatment — all cases that involve complicated decisions based on imperfect information.

Nonetheless it's looking like computers have taken over another game some people thought might remain the domain of humans for some time. Bots have been doing well playing online for some time now, but there they can target weaker players and also benefit from information asymmetry in being able to utilized datamined information against other players and also the benefit of the other players not knowing they're a bot. This is the first 'fair playing field' event where a bot has crushed the humans.

The event is only half over, but the structure of the event makes it fairly clear that the bot is simply crushing them and not experiencing favorable variance. It is playing against 4 pros with each group of two pros playing mirrored hands from one another. So if the bot gets AA vs KK in one hand and wins a stack, it will be getting KK vs AA and losing a stack in the mirrored version. So 'cooler' situations don't play much of a role. And psychology is likely already coming into play for the humans. They've gotta keep showing up day after day to play for hours against a machine that is completely brutalizing them. Not easy to keep on your A game in that situation.
